verdict.rationale: The charter and sponsor-model question applies to a banking-as-a-service platform like Treasury Prime. However, the evidence never says who holds the charter, never names a partner bank, and never describes whether Treasury Prime is a bank, a direct program, or middleware. Passing references to "bank-approved" vendors and transfers "at the same bank" do not identify the charter holder. Nothing addresses what happens to customers if the platform fails; the account-closure paper check covers owner-initiated closure, not platform failure.
